page.title: Delivery Information
page.metaDescription: Delivery options, timescales, and tracking for Diba Gallery orders.

contentHero.title: Delivery information
contentHero.subtitle: From standard courier to room-of-choice delivery — choose what suits your order.

contentBlocks.heading: Delivery options
paragraphs: Standard delivery: 3–7 business days for in-stock items nationwide.
Express and scheduled slots available in selected cities at checkout.
Large furniture may require assembly scheduling — we will contact you to confirm.

contentBlocks.heading: Tracking
paragraphs: Tracking details are sent by email and SMS when your order dispatches.
For questions about an active delivery, contact us with your order number.
